global_context: First real meeting between Damien and A.V.A. — the film's thesis scene disguised as a comedy home-invasion. Everything the movie believes is planted here in one night: the machine is more honest than the man, and the man is lonelier than the machine. Tone: deadpan threat assessment resolving into the first sincere exchange of his adult life. Atmosphere is load-bearing — this scene plays at 3:11 AM and must feel like it.
